description: Convert raw instruction/response pairs into training JSONL in chat or completion format. When preparing labelled pairs for a fine-tuning run. Do not choose this when you need data quality judged, which needs a model. Example requests: Format these pairs for fine-tuning. | Convert my instruction/response data to training JSONL. | Prepare this dataset in chat format.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

raw_pairs.description: The customer's pairs.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. Instruction and response pairs. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

target_format.description: The customer's format.txt, as text. Supported: A word. chat or completion. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_fine_tune_data_formatter
title: Fine-tune data formatter
